title: Accounting Information Systems 2
duration: 30 hours of lectures, 90 hours of self-study, 15 hours of discussion/practical sessions

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Internal Control and Accounting Information Systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Describe basic activities and related objects in business processes for organizing and performing accounting work.
Organize basic data and document flows in business processes to provide information for decision-making.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Basic Activities and Data Flow Analysis
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and organize basic activities and data flows in business processes based on analysis and evaluation of business activities.
Identify risks and appropriate control activities for basic operations in accounting information systems.
Develop basic IT skills for learning, research, and practical application in accounting information systems.
Build critical thinking skills to evaluate the application of policies and analyze risks in accounting information systems.
Practice system thinking skills in organizing appropriate accounting information systems for business processes.
Organize planning, coordination, management of resources, assessment, and improvement of operational efficiency.
